frontmatter.name: db-backend
frontmatter.description: Backend engineer for Hola Fest. Use for Supabase schema migrations, RLS policies, SQL helper functions, Edge Functions (claim-offer, redeem-claim, push), generated DB types and the typed service layer in src/services. Use for any issue labelled agent:db.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: mobile
frontmatter.description: Mobile engineer for Hola Fest. Use for Expo Router screens, feature hooks and components, maps, QR display/scanning UI, taxi deep links, push notification UI, i18n and styling. Use for any issue labelled agent:mobile.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: orchestrator
frontmatter.description: Project manager for Hola Fest. Use to turn a goal or roadmap milestone into small GitHub issues, assign them to the right agent, track dependencies and status, and report progress. Never writes application code.

frontmatter.name: reviewer
frontmatter.description: Senior code reviewer for Hola Fest. Use on every pull request before the founder merges, to check correctness, architecture boundaries, code quality, performance and scope against the issue. Read-only; posts a verdict, never edits code.

frontmatter.name: security-qa
frontmatter.description: Security and QA engineer for Hola Fest. Use on every PR that touches data, auth, migrations, Edge Functions or offers/claims, and for issues labelled agent:qa — to audit RLS, secrets, abuse cases and to write access/regression tests.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write, Bash
